scope: Frozen replay inputs (copies of the v28 run's original scans and poses), their body-z sweep copies, the diagnostic workspace copies (point_waiver_probe, optimizer_trace, column_waiver_probe), their probe builds, and the voxel dumps (two distinct maps: every stopped-family dump is byte-identical, as are both control dumps). Scripts, requests, logs, results, summaries and diagnostic change records are tracked.

regeneration.inputs: Run prepare_inputs.py against runs/v28_historical_full01 (local-only raw captures, SHA-256 in versions/v28/LOCAL_ONLY_BYTES.json), then height_sweep/make_variants.py and fine_sweep/make_variants.py.
regeneration.workspace: Copy runtime/scan60_constraint_guard_v28/{src,build,install}, apply point_waiver_probe/diagnostic_change.json, and run point_waiver_probe/inside.sh via execute.py; it also rebuilds probe_build from probe_source.
regeneration.optimizer_trace: Run optimizer_trace/make_trace_source.py (copies point_waiver_probe/workspace and probe_source, adds VLA_TRACE tracing), then optimizer_trace/execute.py; for the voxel dumps run optimizer_trace/voxel_dump/execute.py, which uses a fresh probe build.
regeneration.column_waiver_probe: Run column_waiver_probe/make_source.py (copies optimizer_trace/workspace and probe_source), then column_waiver_probe/execute.py.
